text:
**The evidence does not establish whether the 2021 tree-cover loss was illegal.** Determining that would require information about the activity, applicable rules and any authorizations.

Satellite data mapped about 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss on the property in 2021. Of that, 68.1 ha was in mapped planted forest, and 13.2 ha was outside mapped forest; none was in mapped native forest. Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting and does not by itself establish deforestation, land-use change or the cause of the loss.
